mike-knoop.bio: Mike Knoop co-founded Zapier, then launched the ARC Prize in 2024 with François Chollet to speed progress toward artificial general intelligence.

facts.text: Zapier co-founder who launched the ARC Prize in 2024.

francois-chollet.bio: Creator of Keras and of the ARC-AGI benchmark, the test of general intelligence this whole competition is built on.

facts.text: Defined the ARC-AGI benchmark in 2019 to measure general intelligence.
The ARC-AGI repository is hosted under his own fchollet GitHub account.
